app.notes:
Much easier to use with a TV remote: what you're on is always clearly highlighted, on every theme
The remote never gets stuck any more after opening a page, a settings section, or a song
Pressing a number button on any menu opens the stage with the code typed, like a videoke machine
Up and Down always leave a text box, and the stage search opens on its search box
Keypad buttons now show their full names: Tempo, Melody, Reserve, Reserve List, and 1st Reserve
MIDI, KAR, and zipped songs named by a number keep that number as their song code
Songs named only by a number show the title and artist written inside the file, and search finds them by both
